description: Source code for managing webhook storage in Mattermost, including CRUD operations for incoming and outgoing webhooks, cache invalidation, and analytics counts.

classes.name: SqlWebhookStore
classes.description: Struct implementing storage operations for webhooks, including methods for CRUD, cache invalidation, and analytics.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Clears internal caches related to webhooks.

methods.name: SaveIncoming
methods.description: Saves a new incoming webhook to the database.

methods.name: UpdateIncoming
methods.description: Updates an existing incoming webhook.

methods.name: GetIncoming
methods.description: Retrieves an incoming webhook by ID.

methods.name: DeleteIncoming
methods.description: Marks an incoming webhook as deleted.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteIncomingByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes incoming webhooks associated with a user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteIncomingByChannel
methods.description: Permanently deletes incoming webhooks associated with a channel.

methods.name: GetIncomingList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of incoming webhooks with pagination.

methods.name: GetIncomingListByUser
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhooks for a specific user.

methods.name: GetIncomingByTeamByUser
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhooks for a specific team and user.

methods.name: GetIncomingByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhooks for a specific team.

methods.name: GetIncomingByChannel
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhooks for a specific channel.

methods.name: SaveOutgoing
methods.description: Saves a new outgoing webhook.

methods.name: GetOutgoing
methods.description: Retrieves an outgoing webhook by ID.

methods.name: GetOutgoingListByUser
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks for a specific user.

methods.name: GetOutgoingList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of outgoing webhooks.

methods.name: GetOutgoingByChannelByUser
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks for a specific channel and user.

methods.name: GetOutgoingByChannel
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks for a specific channel.

methods.name: GetOutgoingByTeamByUser
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks for a specific team and user.

methods.name: GetOutgoingByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks for a specific team.

methods.name: DeleteOutgoing
methods.description: Marks an outgoing webhook as deleted.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteOutgoingByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes outgoing webhooks for a user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteOutgoingByChannel
methods.description: Permanently deletes outgoing webhooks for a channel.

methods.name: UpdateOutgoing
methods.description: Updates an existing outgoing webhook.

methods.name: AnalyticsIncomingCount
methods.description: Returns count of incoming webhooks, optionally filtered by team and user.

methods.name: AnalyticsOutgoingCount
methods.description: Returns count of outgoing webhooks, optionally filtered by team.
